fields.label: Appearance
fields.help: Customize the overall color settings and theme behavior of the image grid.

fields.label: Color Scheme
fields.help: Choose a color scheme to apply on this section container.

fields.label: Section Width
fields.help: Select whether the section should span the full width of the screen or use a fixed width container.

fields.label: Images Setup
fields.help: Upload and manage the landscape and thumbnail images for the grid layout.

fields.label: Landscape Image
fields.help: Upload the main large landscape banner image for the grid layout.

fields.label: Small Image 1
fields.help: Upload the first small thumbnail image to be displayed in the grid.

fields.label: Small Image 2
fields.help: Upload the second small thumbnail image to be displayed in the grid.

fields.label: Style & Border
fields.help: Configure borders, corners, rounding, and spacing values for the images.

fields.label: Border Thickness
fields.help: Adjust the outline border width of grid images in pixels.

fields.label: Border Roundness
fields.help: Smooth and round the corners of the images. Use higher values for round cards.
